risk_if_not_implemented: Without Artificial Intelligence and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) & AI Agent Categorization, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Sensitive Data / Compliance Exposure from Unsanctioned AI Use (R-AI-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Autonomous Technologies Governance
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure policies, processes, procedures and practices related to the mapping, measuring and managing of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related risks are in place, transparent and implemented effectively.
compensating_control_1.justification: Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Autonomous Technologies Governance (AAT-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Artificial Intelligence and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) & AI Agent Categorization (AAT-07.2) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Risk Assessment
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct recurring assessments of risk that includes the likelihood and magnitude of harm, from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification or destruction of the organization's Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
compensating_control_2.justification: Risk Assessment (RSK-13) provides periodic assessment and verification that compensates for the absence of Artificial Intelligence and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) & AI Agent Categorization (AAT-07.2) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
